methods.label: Compare regular-polygon properties
methods.explanation: The circumcircle and incircle of a regular polygon have the same center (the center of the regular polygon). The apothem is less than the radius. For a regular \(n\)-gon, where \(n\ge3\) is the number of sides, the central angle is \(360^\circ/n\) and the interior angle is \((n-2)180^\circ/n\). These angles are equal only when \(n=4\), so C is not true for regular polygons in general. Therefore the correct choice is B.
